# Information security

## Identity and authorization

The repository implements no sign-in, authorization roles, app registrations, OAuth/MSAL flow, scopes, managed identity, or identity-provider integration. The review is a static interface; its controls are not an authenticated business workflow (`README.md:1-7`, `Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/index.html:18-20`).

## Secrets and configuration

There is no Key Vault integration, secret lookup, backend app setting, or workflow secret requirement evidenced in the repository. The supplied resolved-configuration input contains no usable values. Consequently, a production Key Vault name, client ID, tenant ID, allowed-origin list, and redirect URI cannot be determined; none should be inferred from checked-in prototype material.

## Data and sensitivity

The review stores named motion preferences in browser `localStorage` under `claycoLeadership.motionSets.v1`; each set has an ID, name, and motion settings, with at most 30 retained (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/review.js:31-33,109,252-254`). The separate motion study stores settings under `claycoMotionOptions.v3` and named sets under `claycoMotionSets.v1` (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/Clayco Home Motion Options.html:780-791,1177-1198`). Prototype intro playback is remembered for the current browser session under `clayco-intro-seen` (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/designs/sam-alcarez-original/assets/home-intro.js:8,21-22,45`). These preferences are browser-local and are not uploaded by the application. A URL can also encode the selected design and motion mix (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/review.js:42-48`).

No database, cloud storage, analytics, tracking-cookie, credential, or personal-account handling is evidenced in this repository. Some prototype/study pages load public media from external hosts, and links take visitors to public websites; these requests are made by the visitor's browser (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/Clayco Home Motion Options.html:659,697-704`, `animated/project-ljc.html:92`). Pages specify `noindex,nofollow` (`index.html:2-4`, `Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/index.html:3-7`).

## Trust boundaries and exposure

The hosted site is publicly addressable at the URL advertised by the README (`README.md:5`). Prototype pages contain outbound links to public sites and some load public media; these are unauthenticated browser requests, not application API integrations. The review uses `postMessage` with its preview iframe and validates the reply's source and origin (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/motion-bridge.js:6-12,18-29`). The offline package also opens public links in a separate tab (`Clayco Landing Page Studies/review/motion-frame.js:60-72`).

No network perimeter, allowed-origin configuration, or production identity configuration is present in the repository. The actual hostnames serving the site beyond the README's published URL are not established by the checked-in files.
